ov: باتون (الإنجليزية: Patton) فلم دراما حربي أمريكي من إنتاج عام 1970 يتناول قصة القائد العسكري الأمريكي جورج باتون خلال الحرب العالمية الثانية. حقق الفلم نجاحًا ملحوظًا وحاز 7 جوائز أوسكار من أصل 10 لأفضل فلم وأفضل إخراج، وأفضل ممثل بدور رئيس لجورج سي سكوت الذي رفض استلام الجائزة معتبرًا ان صناعة التمثيل لا منافسة فيها منتقدًا الجائزة وأسلوب التصويت فيها. في عام 2003 وصفت مكتبة الكونغرس الفلم بأنه «مهم من الناحية الثقافية والتاريخية والجمالية» واختير للحفظ في السجل الوطني للأفلام.
plotEn:
General Patton, in full dress uniform, mounts a stage in front of an oversized American flag and delivers an unapologetic proclamation of American greatness to inspire soldiers of his command who are about to go into battle for the first time.
American forces have just fought their first major land battle against the Germans in World War II, and suffered a severe defeat at the Battle of Kasserine Pass in North Africa. Hard-charging General George S. Patton is sent to relieve the commander of II Corps, imposing strict discipline that succeeds in rebuilding confidence. Frustrated by what he perceives as British commander Bernard Montgomery's monopolization of the Allied effort, Patton leads the rejuvenated corps to redemption with a significant victory at the Battle of El Guettar.
With the Axis forces in North Africa destroyed, Patton and Montgomery propose competing plans for the Allied invasion of Sicily. Patton recommends landing his U.S. Seventh Army near Palermo. Commanding officer Harold Alexander opts for Montgomery's more cautious plan, landing Patton’s forces at Gela. Although initially intended to support Montgomery, Patton pushes northwest, taking Palermo and racing to Messina before the British. During the campaign, he visits a field hospital and slaps a soldier for cowardice, sparking public outrage at home.
